Abstract.AbstractText: Two recent papers report the activation of a pro-inflammatory response by cytoplasmic DNA from aberrant nuclear structures called micronuclei. The findings have implications for tumor immunity, immunotherapy biomarker discovery, and possibly the many-sided effects of senescence-associated secretory phenotype.
